description: Futures contracts ranked by one numeric column on the latest complete bucket at the key plan's interval, on one venue (`exchange`) or across every futures venue the plan includes. `rows` is an array of { exchange, symbol, baseAsset, value } in `order` (`desc`, the default, is largest first), with the bucket's `ts` (epoch milliseconds, with `tsIso`) and `interval`. `baseAsset` (e.g. BTC) keeps one coin, which with no `exchange` puts that coin's contracts on every venue side by side; `contractType` keeps `perpetual` or `dated` contracts. `limit` is 1 to 100 (default 50). `metric` is a numeric key from blackforge_catalog `futures.metrics`, e.g. fundingRate, openInterestValue, quoteVolume, or liqLongNotional (Max and up). A funding rate is per the venue's funding interval, which is not the same on every venue.

baseAsset.description: One coin as `baseAsset` spells it, e.g. BTC (kucoin XBT reads BTC).

exchange.description: One futures venue. Omitted: every futures venue the plan includes.

metric.description: Numeric futures column key, e.g. fundingRate.

order.description: desc (largest first, the default) or asc.

name: blackforge_futures_top
title: BlackForge futures ranking
